d: Saudi Arabia’s global ambitions face scrutiny following the execution of two Bangladeshi nationals in Mecca, raising questions about transparency, consular rights and capital punishment. Bangladesh says it was not informed before the executions, prompting concerns over diplomatic obligations and the kingdom’s justice system. Meanwhile, Turkey’s repeated references to Kashmir at international forums have strained ties with India.
